family.description: This entry represents the uncharacterised C-terminal domain of secreted (or membrane-anchored) pullulanases of Gram-negative bacteria and pullulanase-type starch debranching enzymes of plants [[cite:PUB00097791]]. Both enzymes hydrolyse alpha-1,6 glycosidic linkages. Pullulan is an unusual, industrially important polysaccharide in which short alpha-1,4 chains (maltotriose) are connected in alpha-1,6 linkages. Enzymes that cleave alpha-1,6 linkages in pullulan and release maltotriose are called pullulanases although pullulan itself may not be the natural substrate.
family.name: Alpha-1,6-glucosidases, pullulanase-type, C-terminal
